objectives: Order a meal politely in a restaurant
Ask about ingredients and recommend dishes

grammar.explanation: In a restaurant, use can, could and would to make polite requests. Could is softer and more polite than can: "Could I see the menu, please?". When you order food, say "I would like ..." or the short form "I'd like ...", and add "please" at the end. To offer politely, use "Would you like ...?".
grammar.explanationAr: في المطعم نستخدم can و could و would للطلب المهذب. صيغة could ألطف من can مثل: Could I see the menu, please؟ وعند طلب الطعام قل I would like أو صورتها المختصرة I'd like وأضف please في نهاية الطلب. وللعرض بأدب استخدم Would you like ...؟
